# 📱 Phone Link AOSP Port **Full Samsung-tier *Link to Windows* features on rooted AOSP Android 16.** [![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/lang-English-1f6feb?style=for-the-badge)](README.md) [![Русский](https://img.shields.io/badge/lang-Русский-d93025?style=for-the-badge)](README.ru.md) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/badge/Release-v2.1.0-2ea44f?style=flat-square&logo=github)](https://github.com/Fleshoo/phonelink-aosp-module/releases/latest) [![Android](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-16%20(SDK%2036)-3ddc84?style=flat-square&logo=android&logoColor=white)](#requirements) [![Device](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tested-Xiaomi%20Mi%209%20(cepheus)-ff6900?style=flat-square&logo=xiaomi&logoColor=white)](#requirements) [![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tests-349%2F349%20Passed-2ea44f?style=flat-square)](#build--tests) [**Download Latest Release**](https://github.com/Fleshoo/phonelink-aosp-module/releases/latest)
--- ## What It Does - **Phone Screen Mirroring** — Streams Android screen to Windows PC without One UI firmware or repeating `MediaProjection` prompts. - **Hardware Encoding** — Redirects Samsung encoder lookups to Qualcomm `c2.qti.avc.encoder` / `c2.qti.hevc.encoder` with instant IDR sync frames. - **Remote Input & Clipboard** — Translates PC mouse, keyboard (`/dev/uinput`), navigation clicks, and clipboard sync. - **AOSP Stability** — Suppresses incompatible One UI `BlackScreen` overlays/`.spr` assets and prevents MDX teardown crashes when stopping mirroring from the phone. > [!NOTE] > Tested on **Xiaomi Mi 9 (`cepheus`)** running **Project Infinity X (Android 16 / SDK 36)**. Other rooted Android 16 AOSP devices on Qualcomm SoCs can work too; other Android versions or SoCs (MediaTek/Exynos/Tensor) may require hook/codec adjustments. --- ## Requirements - **OS:** Android 16 (SDK 36) AOSP custom ROM - **Root + Hooks:** Magisk v26+ (or KernelSU / APatch with Zygisk) + **LSPosed** - **Apps:** **Microsoft Link to Windows** (`com.microsoft.appmanager`) on Android + **Phone Link** on Windows 10/11 --- ## Installation 1. **Remove any user-installed MDX (if present):** ```bash adb shell pm uninstall com.samsung.android.mdx ``` 2. **Download [`PhoneLinkMagisk-v2.1.0.zip`](https://github.com/Fleshoo/phonelink-aosp-module/releases/latest) and [`PhoneLinkXposed.apk`](https://github.com/Fleshoo/phonelink-aosp-module/releases/latest) from Releases.** 3. **Flash `PhoneLinkMagisk-v2.1.0.zip`** in Magisk / KernelSU Manager (*Modules → Install from storage*). Do not reboot yet. 4. **Install `PhoneLinkXposed.apk`** (`adb install -r PhoneLinkXposed.apk`), open **LSPosed Manager → Modules → Phone Link Port**, enable it, and check **all 3 scopes**: - `android` (System Framework) - `com.microsoft.appmanager` (Link to Windows) - `com.samsung.android.mdx` (Link to Windows Service) 5. **Reboot** and pair your PC in **Link to Windows**. --- ## PC Controls | Input on PC | Action on Android | | :--- | :--- | | **Left Click / Drag / Scroll** | Tap / Swipe / Scroll on virtual display | | **Right Click** | **Back** (`KEYCODE_BACK`) | | **Middle Click** | **Home** (`KEYCODE_HOME`) | | **Keyboard / Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V** | Hardware text input (`/dev/uinput`) & clipboard sync | --- ## Architecture ```mermaid flowchart LR PC["Windows PC
Phone Link"] <-->|"WebRTC + Input / Clipboard"| AM["com.microsoft.appmanager
(AppManagerHooks)"] AM <-->|"AIDL / Providers"| MDX["com.samsung.android.mdx
(Magisk Priv-App + MdxServiceHooks)"] MDX -->|"MediaProjection + c2.qti.* + InputManager"| SYS["system_server
(SystemServerHooks)"] ```
Source Modules, Troubleshooting & Build / Tests ### Modules - [`AppManagerHooks.java`](lsposed_module/app/src/main/java/me/phonelink/xposed/hooks/AppManagerHooks.java) — `SM-G998B` spoofing, `SemFloatingFeature` stubs, auto-accepted permissions, `BlackScreen` disabled - [`MdxServiceHooks.java`](lsposed_module/app/src/main/java/me/phonelink/xposed/hooks/MdxServiceHooks.java) — `VirtualDisplay` / `MediaProjection` bridge, `WindowContext` / `.spr` fixes, safe `AppExecutionContainerService` teardown - [`SystemServerHooks.java`](lsposed_module/app/src/main/java/me/phonelink/xposed/hooks/SystemServerHooks.java) — Headless `MediaProjection` grant & `O(1)` `INJECT_EVENTS` UID cache - [`InputInjectionHooks.java`](lsposed_module/app/src/main/java/me/phonelink/xposed/hooks/InputInjectionHooks.java) & [`VideoCodecHooks.java`](lsposed_module/app/src/main/java/me/phonelink/xposed/hooks/VideoCodecHooks.java) — Display-targeted input, Back/Home chords, `c2.qti.*` encoder mapping - [`magisk_module/`](magisk_module/) — `/system/priv-app/LinkToWindowsService` overlay, XML allowlists, `/dev/uinput` permissions ### Troubleshooting - **Boot log:** `adb shell su -c "cat /data/local/tmp/phonelink_service.log"` - **Hook logs:** `adb logcat -s PhoneLinkInit PhoneLink-SystemServerHooks PhoneLink-InputInjectionHooks PhoneLink-VideoCodec PhoneLink-MdxService PhoneLink-AppManager` - **No screen mirroring / permission loop:** Check all 3 LSPosed scopes (`android`, `com.microsoft.appmanager`, `com.samsung.android.mdx`) and reboot. - **No video on non-Qualcomm SoC:** Update encoder names in [`VideoCodecHooks.java`](lsposed_module/app/src/main/java/me/phonelink/xposed/hooks/VideoCodecHooks.java). ### Build & Tests Requires **Python 3.10+** and **JDK 17+**. Place `LinkToWindowsService.apk` into `magisk_module/system/priv-app/LinkToWindowsService/` before building the Magisk ZIP. ```bash python build.py --test # Build Magisk ZIP + LSPosed APK + SHA256SUMS.txt & run 349 tests python lsposed_module/build_lsposed.py # Build LSPosed APK only python tests/test_runner.py # Run E2E test suite (349 tests / 5 tiers) ```
readmeHTML:
📱 Phone Link AOSP Port

**Full Samsung-tier *Link to Windows* features on rooted AOSP Android 16.**

![English](README.md)

![Русский](README.ru.md)

![Release](https://github.com/Fleshoo/phonelink-aosp-module/releases/latest)

![Android-3ddc84?style=flat-square&logo=android&logoColor=white)](#requirements)

![Device-ff6900?style=flat-square&logo=xiaomi&logoColor=white)](#requirements)

![Tests](#build--tests)

Download Latest Release

---

What It Does

  • **Phone Screen Mirroring** — Streams Android screen to Windows PC without One UI firmware or repeating `MediaProjection` prompts.
  • **Hardware Encoding** — Redirects Samsung encoder lookups to Qualcomm `c2.qti.avc.encoder` / `c2.qti.hevc.encoder` with instant IDR sync frames.
  • **Remote Input & Clipboard** — Translates PC mouse, keyboard (`/dev/uinput`), navigation clicks, and clipboard sync.
  • **AOSP Stability** — Suppresses incompatible One UI `BlackScreen` overlays/`.spr` assets and prevents MDX teardown crashes when stopping mirroring from the phone.

    • > [!NOTE]

    > Tested on Xiaomi Mi 9 (cepheus) running Project Infinity X (Android 16 / SDK 36). Other rooted Android 16 AOSP devices on Qualcomm SoCs can work too; other Android versions or SoCs (MediaTek/Exynos/Tensor) may require hook/codec adjustments.

    ---

    Requirements

  • **OS:** Android 16 (SDK 36) AOSP custom ROM
  • **Root + Hooks:** Magisk v26+ (or KernelSU / APatch with Zygisk) + **LSPosed**
  • **Apps:** **Microsoft Link to Windows** (`com.microsoft.appmanager`) on Android + **Phone Link** on Windows 10/11

    • ---

    Installation

  • **Remove any user-installed MDX (if present):**

    • ```bash

    adb shell pm uninstall com.samsung.android.mdx

    ```

  • **Download [`PhoneLinkMagisk-v2.1.0.zip`](https://github.com/Fleshoo/phonelink-aosp-module/releases/latest) and [`PhoneLinkXposed.apk`](https://github.com/Fleshoo/phonelink-aosp-module/releases/latest) from Releases.**
  • **Flash `PhoneLinkMagisk-v2.1.0.zip`** in Magisk / KernelSU Manager (*Modules → Install from storage*). Do not reboot yet.
  • **Install `PhoneLinkXposed.apk`** (`adb install -r PhoneLinkXposed.apk`), open **LSPosed Manager → Modules → Phone Link Port**, enable it, and check **all 3 scopes**:

    • - android (System Framework)

    - com.microsoft.appmanager (Link to Windows)

    - com.samsung.android.mdx (Link to Windows Service)

  • **Reboot** and pair your PC in **Link to Windows**.

    • ---

    PC Controls

    | Input on PC | Action on Android |

    | :--- | :--- |

    | Left Click / Drag / Scroll | Tap / Swipe / Scroll on virtual display |

    | Right Click | Back (KEYCODE_BACK) |

    | Middle Click | Home (KEYCODE_HOME) |

    | Keyboard / Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V | Hardware text input (/dev/uinput) & clipboard sync |

    ---

    Architecture

    flowchart LR
    PC["Windows PC<br/>Phone Link"] <-->|"WebRTC + Input / Clipboard"| AM["com.microsoft.appmanager<br/>(AppManagerHooks)"]
    AM <-->|"AIDL / Providers"| MDX["com.samsung.android.mdx<br/>(Magisk Priv-App + MdxServiceHooks)"]
    MDX -->|"MediaProjection + c2.qti.* + InputManager"| SYS["system_server<br/>(SystemServerHooks)"]

    Source Modules, Troubleshooting & Build / Tests

    Modules

  • [`AppManagerHooks.java`](lsposed_module/app/src/main/java/me/phonelink/xposed/hooks/AppManagerHooks.java) — `SM-G998B` spoofing, `SemFloatingFeature` stubs, auto-accepted permissions, `BlackScreen` disabled
  • [`MdxServiceHooks.java`](lsposed_module/app/src/main/java/me/phonelink/xposed/hooks/MdxServiceHooks.java) — `VirtualDisplay` / `MediaProjection` bridge, `WindowContext` / `.spr` fixes, safe `AppExecutionContainerService` teardown
  • [`SystemServerHooks.java`](lsposed_module/app/src/main/java/me/phonelink/xposed/hooks/SystemServerHooks.java) — Headless `MediaProjection` grant & `O(1)` `INJECT_EVENTS` UID cache
  • [`InputInjectionHooks.java`](lsposed_module/app/src/main/java/me/phonelink/xposed/hooks/InputInjectionHooks.java) & [`VideoCodecHooks.java`](lsposed_module/app/src/main/java/me/phonelink/xposed/hooks/VideoCodecHooks.java) — Display-targeted input, Back/Home chords, `c2.qti.*` encoder mapping
  • [`magisk_module/`](magisk_module/) — `/system/priv-app/LinkToWindowsService` overlay, XML allowlists, `/dev/uinput` permissions

    • Troubleshooting

  • **Boot log:** `adb shell su -c "cat /data/local/tmp/phonelink_service.log"`
  • **Hook logs:** `adb logcat -s PhoneLinkInit PhoneLink-SystemServerHooks PhoneLink-InputInjectionHooks PhoneLink-VideoCodec PhoneLink-MdxService PhoneLink-AppManager`
  • **No screen mirroring / permission loop:** Check all 3 LSPosed scopes (`android`, `com.microsoft.appmanager`, `com.samsung.android.mdx`) and reboot.
  • **No video on non-Qualcomm SoC:** Update encoder names in [`VideoCodecHooks.java`](lsposed_module/app/src/main/java/me/phonelink/xposed/hooks/VideoCodecHooks.java).

    • Build & Tests

    Requires Python 3.10+ and JDK 17+. Place LinkToWindowsService.apk into magisk_module/system/priv-app/LinkToWindowsService/ before building the Magisk ZIP.

    python build.py --test                # Build Magisk ZIP + LSPosed APK + SHA256SUMS.txt & run 349 tests
python lsposed_module/build_lsposed.py  # Build LSPosed APK only
python tests/test_runner.py             # Run E2E test suite (349 tests / 5 tiers)
